title: Tiny, cute drum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- drum body -->
  <rect x='22' y='38' width='56' height='34' rx='6' fill='#d94f3a'/>
  <!-- shading on body -->
  <rect x='22' y='58' width='56' height='14' rx='6' fill='#b83a28'/>
  <!-- top rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='28' ry='9' fill='#f5d76e'/>
  <!-- drum head (top skin) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='37' rx='23' ry='6.5' fill='#fdf3d0'/>
  <!-- head shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='39' rx='23' ry='4' fill='#ecd9a2' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- bottom rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='28' ry='9' fill='#e0b84f'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='28' ry='9' fill='#c99a2e' opacity='0.0'/>
  <!-- tension rods -->
  <rect x='27' y='40' width='3' height='30' rx='1.5' fill='#f5d76e'/>
  <rect x='70' y='40' width='3' height='30' rx='1.5' fill='#f5d76e'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='43' width='3' height='27' rx='1.5' fill='#f5d76e'/>
  <!-- lugs -->
  <rect x='25' y='52' width='7' height='6' rx='2' fill='#f9e9a8'/>
  <rect x='68' y='52' width='7' height='6' rx='2' fill='#f9e9a8'/>
  <rect x='46.5' y='55' width='7' height='6' rx='2' fill='#f9e9a8'/>
  <!-- drumsticks -->
  <rect x='58' y='14' width='4' height='28' rx='2' fill='#e8b86b' transform='rotate(18 60 28)'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='13' r='4' fill='#f2c98a'/>
  <rect x='36' y='16' width='4' height='26' rx='2' fill='#e8b86b' transform='rotate(-16 38 29)'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='16' r='4' fill='#f2c98a'/>
  <!-- shine on head -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='35' rx='8' ry='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
